authority: User requested completion with fully LLM annotation and zero human annotation.

prior_exposure.reason_for_followup: Investigate underrepresented high-score strata after negative v3; no claim that lack of tail coverage explains all negative judgments.

first_cell.representation: original frozen CPU FP32 E5 with complete source-disjoint scientific cache/frame admission through separately versioned adapter
first_cell.pair_eligibility: All unordered pairs of the admitted calibration partition, including two records from the same source group. Source-disjoint means between training/calibration/test partitions; it does not exclude within-calibration same-source pairs.

models.qualified_scope: 40 exposed engineering pairs plus 4 swapped calls only; not semantic accuracy, scientific-frame coverage, or calibration

effective_constraint_policy.word_count_semantics: Python str.split on decoded reason value
effective_constraint_policy.selection: Descending finite native-proposal score, then lowest token ID; first candidate whose exact tokenizer-state transition passes full schema and decoded-word guard
effective_constraint_policy.logit_argmax_evidence: Runtime code, assertions and candidate-count ledger; no independent full-logit replay

standalone_token_policy.eos_policy: Separate EOS IDs; permitted only after complete guarded JSON
standalone_token_policy.scope: Narrower token vocabulary; valid split-codepoint tokens and literal U+FFFD are excluded

judge_runtime.scheduling: per model, stage: full_input_tokens descending then frozen sample index; no label-dependent ordering
judge_runtime.loading: offline exact pinned model/tokenizer/config/template files; bind weight hashes, package versions, code, driver/GPU and actual effective decoding config before and after execution
judge_runtime.scope: Adopt qualified pilot numerical/grammar settings. A separate v3 runner must bind new sampling/seed/response roles; sealed engineering pilot CLIs must not be relabeled as substantive runners.

prompt.renderer: same pilot renderer: system message then json.dumps({task_definition, documents:[{label:A,text:text_a},{label:B,text:text_b}]}, ensure_ascii=False); pinned model chat template, add_generation_prompt=True; tokenize add_special_tokens=False, truncation=False
prompt.displayed_fields: complete original texts and fixed task only; no IDs, score, stratum, method, tags, native duplicate labels, prior answers, outcomes or desired conclusion
prompt.reason_limit: <=80 Python str.split words and <=600 characters; strict final schema; no JSON repair or fence stripping
prompt.untrusted_text_rule: document instructions are quoted source data; model receives no tools/retrieval and never sees the other model response

model_labels.primary_positive_rule: both distinct-family judge outputs valid and positive
model_labels.uncertain_disagreement_unavailable_rule: binary positive/nonpositive disagreement, uncertainty, or unavailable: zero positive numerator; retain full denominator weight and distinct status. Different positive categories remain panel-positive and are logged as six-way disagreement.
model_labels.label_function: y(pair)=1 iff both model calls have status valid and categories in the two positive categories; else 0

validation_stability.overlap_rule: For selection/validation overlap under identical canonical orientation, compare each model status and each valid six-way category. Any category change OR status/availability change makes model validation unavailable due to instability, regardless of the numerical lower bound. No majority over repeats, relabeling, agreement retries or outcome-dependent exclusion.
validation_stability.no_overlap_limit: Absence of replayed overlap does not establish label-function stability elsewhere; report zero overlap explicitly.
validation_stability.statistical_assumption: Bounds condition on a fixed/potential panel-label function. Passing observed replay checks does not prove deterministic stability on unsampled pairs or semantic accuracy.

swapped_diagnostics.pairs_per_stage: ceil(actual stage sample count/10), SRS without replacement using separate committed stage-swap seed
swapped_diagnostics.scope: descriptive six-way and binary order sensitivity only; retain failures and full diagnostic denominator; no primary quality gain or new independence claim

selection.frame: All 220405510 unordered pairs in the unchanged 20996-record calibration frame, including within-source pairs.
selection.stratum_rule: k = bisect_left(cuts, raw_score); (-infinity,c0], (c0,c1], ..., (last,+infinity); no score clipping.
selection.algorithm: Independent streaming reservoir SRS without replacement in each stratum; census if N_h <30.
selection.inclusion_probability: min(30,N_h)/N_h; retain exact rational inverse weights and every sampled unit.
selection.threshold_rule: Least original grid threshold with exact full-denominator weighted positive ratio >=19/20 and nonzero sampled support; score > float(tau).

validation.validation_frame: ALL score>locked_tau calibration pairs; not only model positives
validation.bound_target: fixed/potential conservative two-model-panel label function under the locked runtime and uniform-draw sampling model; not semantic truth, human judgment, or independent model votes
validation.validation_sampling: independent reservoir SRS without replacement from ALL above-threshold calibration pairs, including selection/pilot overlap, model nonpositive/uncertain/unavailable cases; census if N<200
validation.validation_bound: one-sided exact finite-population hypergeometric lower proportion; alpha=1/20; >=9/10 required; empty population/sample is undefined and fails
validation.validation_failure_policy: stop this configuration, retain failure; any substantive change requires a new protocol and evaluation whose prior exposure is disclosed

randomness.generation: Four independent 256-bit OS seeds drawn once in immutable activation lock before new sample exposure, after code/plan and successful census receipt binding.
randomness.algorithm: Python random.Random; SHA256 domain-separated canonical structured inputs with plan/frame/stage/seed/stratum.
randomness.orientation: V4 plan-domain hash of unordered pair; independent of observed labels. Preserve chosen orientation for selection/validation, including overlap. V4 can differ from v3.
randomness.overlap_policy: Fresh calls for any v3/engineering/selection overlap; retain IDs to disclose exposures; no sample exclusion.

advance_rules.validation_failure: Preserve failure, no retuning or additional prompts/models to rescue this configuration.
advance_rules.empty_strata: No calls for empty strata. Preserve complete populations and exact weights; any empty above-threshold validation frame fails.

scope: Model-defined calibration development for AskUbuntu/E5. Downstream effects require native task labels, frozen settings, real panels, exact correctness, strong B-E baseline and complete costs. No automatic expansion or confirmatory promotion.
